# tabdo

> An AI-native workspace for personal plans and small team projects. Tell tabdo what you want to do; AI organizes information, arranges steps, and makes updates you can review and adjust.

## Docs

- [Docs index](https://tabdo.ai/docs/llms.txt): Full public guide and reference index, including setup, product features, REST, GraphQL, and SDK docs.
- [Welcome](https://tabdo.ai/docs): Start with a personal plan or small team project and find guides for using agents in tabdo and connecting table data through REST, GraphQL, or the JavaScript SDK.
